Description: Infection from infectious mosquito bite leading to clinical disease with probability φ, followed by successful treatment with probability fT
Infection from infectious mosquito bite leading to clinical disease with probability φ, treatment failure with probability (1-fT)
Infection from infectious mosquito bite leading to asymptomatic patent infection with probability (1-φ)
Recovery from treated clinical disease to prophylactic protection at rate rT
Clearance of clinical disease to patent asymptomatic infection at rate rD
Superinfection: new infection in presence of existing untreated clinical disease leading to treated clinical disease
End of prophylactic protection, return to susceptible at rate rP
Transition from patent to sub-patent infection at rate rA, dependent on anti-parasite immunity
Superinfection: new infection leading to clinical disease from patent asymptomatic state
Clearance of sub-patent infection, return to susceptible at rate rU
Superinfection: new infection leading to clinical disease from sub-patent state
Superinfection: new infection leading to asymptomatic patent infection from sub-patent state
Mosquito takes an infectious blood meal from an infectious human (T, D, A, or U states)
Completion of extrinsic incubation period, mosquito becomes infectious

Name: φ
Description: Probability of developing clinical disease on infection, determined by level of anti-disease immunity

Name: fT
Description: Fixed probability of being successfully treated given clinical disease

Name: rT
Description: Rate of transition from treated clinical disease to prophylactic protection

Name: rP
Description: Rate of return from prophylactic protection to susceptible

Name: rD
Description: Rate of clearance of untreated clinical disease to patent asymptomatic infection

Name: rA
Description: Rate of transition from patent asymptomatic to sub-patent infection, depends on anti-parasite immunity

Name: rU
Description: Rate of clearance of sub-patent infection to susceptible

Name: Λ
Description: Force of infection on humans, determined by vector-to-human ratio, biting rate, proportion of infectious mosquitoes, and anti-infection immunity

Name: EIR
Description: Entomological inoculation rate, varies by setting
Unit: infectious bites per person per year

Name: HBI
Description: Human blood index of mosquito species, determines infectivity to humans

Name: LLIN_half_life
Description: Half-life of LLIN protective efficacy due to decaying insecticide and wear-and-tear

Name: LLIN_adherence_decay
Description: Exponential decay rate of LLIN usage/adherence over time

Name: DDT_half_life
Description: Half-life of DDT insecticidal effect for IRS

Name: ACT_prophylaxis_duration
Description: Duration of prophylactic protection provided by ACT in MSAT

Name: vaccine_efficacy
Description: Initial efficacy of RTS,S/AS01 pre-erythrocytic vaccine

Name: vaccine_half_life
Description: Half-life of exponential decay of vaccine efficacy

Name: LLIN_coverage
Description: Target coverage level for LLIN distribution

Name: IRS_coverage
Description: Coverage level for IRS

Name: MSAT_coverage
Description: Coverage level for MSAT (proportion screened)

Name: vaccine_coverage
Description: Coverage level for vaccine based on EPI distribution
